name: AWS DynamoDB
description: The Sumo Logic App for Amazon DynamoDB is a unified logs and metrics (ULM) App which provides operational insights into your DynamoDB solution. The App includes Dashboards that allow you to monitor key metrics and view the throttle events, errors, latency, and help you plan the capacity of your DynamoDB solution.

children.name: Amazon  DynamoDB - Capacity Planning
children.description: See the details of your DynamoDB capacity including the provisioned read/write consumed, read/write throttle events, and throttled requests.

panels.name: Percent of Provisioned Read Consumed

metricsQueries.query: _sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* Namespace=AWS/DynamoDB metric=ProvisionedReadCapacityUnits Statistic=Maximum   Region=* TableName=* | avg by TableName, GlobalSecondaryIndexName

children.name: Amazon DynamoDB - Events
children.description: See the details on events in your DynamoDB including the location, users, errors, updates, creations, and deletions to tables.

panels.name: Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| count by event_name

panels.name: DynamoDB Events Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| count by event_name, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column event_name 
| fillmissing timeslice (1h)

panels.name: Location of Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code, event_name
| sort _count

panels.name: Errors in Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" errorCode
| json field=_raw "errorCode" as error_code
| json field=_raw "errorMessage" as error_msg
| json field=_raw "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| count by error_code, error_msg, event_name, user, src_ip

panels.name: UpdateTable Event
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" UpdateTable !(errorCode)
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.tableName" as table_name
| json field=_raw "responseElements" 
| count by event_name, table_name, user, region, src_ip

panels.name: CreateTable Event
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" CreateTable
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.tableName" as table_name
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.keySchema" as table_schema
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.attributeDefinitions" as attribute_definition 
| json field=_raw "userAgent" as user_agent
| json field=_raw "responseElements.tableDescription.provisionedThroughput" as provisioned_throughput
| count by event_name, table_name, table_schema, attribute_definition, provisioned_throughput, user, region, src_ip

panels.name: DeleteTable Event
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" DeleteTable
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.tableName" as table_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.attributes.mfaAuthenticated" as mfa_authentication 
| count by event_name, table_name,user, region, src_ip, mfa_authentication

panels.name: Top 10 IAM Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| count as count by user
| sort count 
| limit 10

panels.name: Update Time to Live Event
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" UpdateTimeToLive
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "requestParameters" as req_params
| json field=_raw "responseElements" as resp_elements
| count by event_name, region, user, src_ip, req_params, resp_elements

panels.name: DynamoDB Events Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| count by event_name, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column event_name 
| fillmissing timeslice (1h)

panels.name: Throttled Requests by Table and Operation Name

metricsQueries.query: _sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* Namespace=AWS/DynamoDB Region=* Metric=ThrottledRequests Statistic=Sum Region=*

panels.name: Errors in Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com" errorCode
| json field=_raw "errorCode" as error_code
| json field=_raw "errorMessage" as error_msg
| json field=_raw "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| count by error_code, error_msg, event_name, user, src_ip

panels.name: Latency By Table Name

metricsQueries.query: _sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* Namespace=AWS/DynamoDB metric=SuccessfulRequestLatency Statistic=Average Region=* | avg by TableName

panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/DynamoDB* "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "eventName" as event_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user
| count as count by user
| sort count 
| limit 10
